_readMeFirst: v0.12.0 adds pinned Wrangler-local D1 migration validation on top of the merged v0.11.0 Worker + D1 source foundation. The PWA UI still intentionally uses IndexedDB/fake providers. No remote Cloudflare resource is created or deployed by this build.

targetArchitecture.status: Worker/D1 source foundation implemented and local D1 runtime validation staged; remote Cloudflare activation and live providers still pending

pwa.cacheBoundary: same-origin unauthenticated app assets only; /api, cross-origin, and Authorization-bearing requests bypass Cache Storage

backendFoundation.canonicalTitleKey: ${media_type}-${tmdb_id}, enforced by D1 CHECK plus UNIQUE(media_type, tmdb_id)
backendFoundation.crosswalkUpsertRule: later partial provider payloads preserve already-known Trakt/IMDb/availability IDs when the incoming field is omitted
backendFoundation.canonicalMutationPrecondition: Library and rating writes require an existing canonical title and return a controlled conflict when it is missing
backendFoundation.auth: Bearer device token from Worker DEVICE_ACCESS_TOKEN secret; fail closed if unconfigured
backendFoundation.requestTracing: x-request-id on responses; sanitized structured server errors
backendFoundation.localWranglerConfig: wrangler.local.jsonc; local-only placeholder database ID plus preview ID
backendFoundation.localWranglerValidation: scripts/validate-wrangler-d1.mjs applies migrations with --local and verifies schema_version=1, 8 services, titles table, and d1_migrations table

v0110.exactHeadCheckout: pull-request CI explicitly checks out pull_request.head.sha

v0120.requiredWranglerLocalD1: pass with Wrangler 4.129.0 on literal final PR head

hardenedBehaviors: Caught Up requires no gaps through the engaged season while untouched newer seasons are ignored until started
On Hold and Watching Now use real watch timestamps, not manual correction changedAt
Finished series requires provider status Ended
season bulk overrides are bounded to currently known/released episodes
New Season supports future seasons before episode records exist
provider-owned availability reconciliation never touches user-owned stores
Search/Library membership rejects dangling title IDs
D1 Library and rating writes reject missing canonical title IDs as controlled conflicts
D1 canonical IDs are structurally tied to media type and TMDB ID
D1 provider upserts preserve known optional stable crosswalk IDs across later partial payloads
D1 availability represents multiple option types for one title/service
Worker personal routes fail closed without configured auth
unexpected Worker failures do not return raw internal error messages
service worker never app-shell caches personal API, cross-origin, or Authorization-bearing responses
pull-request CI validates the literal PR head SHA rather than relying only on GitHub's synthetic merge ref
D1 migration is validated in both Node SQLite and Wrangler local D1 before any remote activation
History and Library preserve their distinct streaming-service semantics
Alerts remain NEW during first visit and are marked seen on page exit
pendingIntegrations: Explicitly approve and create separate Streamarkr Cloudflare Worker and D1 resources
Activate a real Streamarkr Wrangler config without committing real identifiers or secrets
Migrate frontend repository calls to Worker while retaining IndexedDB caching/offline behavior
physical Pixel 9 Pro Fold validation before V1 release
